about: Phantom Breaker: Battle Grounds Ultimate is a side-scrolling beat'em up with the heart of a fighting game, supporting cross-platform pixel art anime action with up to 8P online multiplayer and all the characters from Phantom Breaker: Battle…

Team up with friends in local co-op or challenge up to 8 fighters from around the world with cross-platform online play.
